      <bpmn:documentation>Duration varies depending on the drink size.</bpmn:documentation>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_AskFriesOrWedges" name="Ask fries or wedges"/>

      <bpmn:documentation>Duration varies depending on the fries size.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareWedges" name="Prepare wedges">
      <bpmn:documentation>Duration varies depending on the wedges size.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SideChoice_Merge" name="Side prepared"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_MenuParallel_Join" name="Menu parts ready"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Burger_Merge" name="Burger preparation starts"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareBurger" name="Prepare burger">
      <bpmn:documentation>Duration varies depending on the number of ingredients. Status updates are given every 30 seconds via the non-interrupting timer.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="BoundaryEvent_StatusTimer" name="Every 30 seconds" attachedToRef="Task_PrepareBurger" cancelActivity="false">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerEventDef_StatusUpdate">
        <bpmn:timeCycle>R/PT30S</bpmn:timeCycle>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GiveStatusUpdate" name="Give enthusiastic status update"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_StatusUpdateGiven" name="Status update given"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DeliverByConveyor" name="Deliver order via conveyor belt"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_OrderDelivered" name="Order delivered"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="Start_OrderReceived" targetRef="Task_AskMenuOrBurger"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_AskMenuOrBurger" targetRef="Gateway_MenuChoice_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03_Menu" name="Menu" sourceRef="Gateway_MenuChoice_Split" targetRef="Gateway_MenuParallel_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04_BurgerOnly" name="Just the burger" sourceRef="Gateway_MenuChoice_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Burger_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Gateway_MenuParallel_Split" targetRef="Task_PrepareDrink"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Gateway_MenuParallel_Split" targetRef="Task_AskFriesOrWedges"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Task_AskFriesOrWedges" targetRef="Gateway_SideChoice_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08_Fries" name="Fries" sourceRef="Gateway_SideChoice_Split" targetRef="Task_PrepareFries"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09_Wedges" name="Wedges" sourceRef="Gateway_SideChoice_Split" targetRef="Task_PrepareWedges"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_PrepareFries" targetRef="Gateway_SideChoice_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_PrepareWedges" targetRef="Gateway_SideChoice_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Gateway_SideChoice_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_MenuParallel_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_PrepareDrink" targetRef="Gateway_MenuParallel_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Gateway_MenuParallel_Join" targetRef="Gateway_Burger_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Gateway_Burger_Merge" targetRef="Task_PrepareBurger"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Task_PrepareBurger" targetRef="Task_DeliverByConveyor"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Task_DeliverByConveyor" targetRef="End_OrderDelivered"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="BoundaryEvent_StatusTimer" targetRef="Task_GiveStatusUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Task_GiveStatusUpdate" targetRef="End_StatusUpdateGiven"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
